text: The client_credentials grant type is used when the client is acting on its own behalf rather than on behalf of a resource owner.
A 302 redirect response is used to return an authorization code to the client via the user-agent.
The invalid_request error is returned when a request is missing a required parameter or is otherwise malformed.
Refresh tokens are always issued alongside access tokens for every single grant type defined in this specification.
Confidential clients are not required to authenticate with the authorization server when requesting a token.
The specification mandates that all authorization servers must support PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) for public clients.
Access tokens must be encrypted with AES-256 before being returned to the client in the token response.
The authorization code grant type requires the client to first obtain an authorization code before requesting an access token.
